note: Nedbank Zimbabwe's 2026 pricing guide (business conditions): an individual's ZiG current account carries a maintenance fee of 70 ZiG a month (5 US dollars on a USD account); its exemption for accounts whose balance stays at or below 100 dollars for up to 30 days isn't written, the waivers the game reads being balances at or above a figure.

sources.title: Nedbank Zimbabwe, Pricing guide 2026 (business conditions)
sources.said: 1.2 Account Maintenance Fees ZiG Account (ZWG) ... Current Account ZWG 70 NIL USD 5 NIL ... Individual and SME accounts with consecutive daily balance of USD 100 and below (or its equivalent in ZWG) for a period up to 30 days are exempt
